_note: Server-only. The KPIs Jev matches each team's KPI rows to. Relevance labels are Fadel's table from Nov 10, 2026 (tied | supports | client | not_tied | process | other). Relevance is never shown before the kpis phase and is never asked of Jev: code looks it up here.

items.name: Accuracy: distance to the X
items.desc: How close the throws land to the X on the whiteboard, summarized in any way (average, median, best, worst distance).

items.name: Consistency or spread
items.desc: How tightly the throws cluster together or how much they vary, wherever they land. Not how close they are to the X.

items.name: Hit rate
items.desc: The share or count of throws that land within some distance of the X or inside a target zone.

items.name: Reaches the board
items.desc: Whether or how often a throw reaches or hits the whiteboard at all.

items.name: Durability
items.desc: Whether the plane survives repeated throws without repair or loses its shape.

items.name: Skill needed to throw
items.desc: How easy the plane is to throw well, or whether anyone could throw it, or how much it depends on the thrower.

items.name: Unit cost
items.desc: The materials in one finished plane (sheets, clips, tape) or its price. Not everything used while developing it.

items.name: Aesthetics
items.desc: How the plane looks: appearance, neatness, style, design appeal.

items.name: Speed, flight time or distance flown
items.desc: How fast it flies, how long it stays in the air, or how far it can fly.

items.name: Weight
items.desc: How heavy or light the plane is.

items.name: Cycle time
items.desc: The time it takes to build one plane, from start to ready. Not the pace required by demand.

items.name: Takt time
items.desc: The pace demand requires: available time divided by the number of planes needed. Not how long one plane actually takes.

items.name: Lead time
items.desc: Total time from the start of design (including testing) to a throw-ready plane.

items.name: People involved
items.desc: How many people work on building or throwing, or labor hours.

items.name: Cost of resources
items.desc: Everything used to develop and build, including scrapped prototypes and wasted paper.

items.name: Prototypes or iterations
items.desc: How many versions or test builds the team made before the final plane.

items.name: Training time
items.desc: Practice time needed to get the thrower or builder ready.
